claims.hypothesis: Is the 4.488 um feature an AGN-excited [Mg IV] line?
claims.experiment: Compared feature width, velocity and spatial distribution with expectations, and checked for [Ar VI]
claims.result: Feature is broad, blue-shifted, bright at clusters and [Ar VI] is not detected
claims.finding: Emission attributed to shocks (stellar activity), not AGN

evidence.quote: These arguments suggest that this emission line is not produced by an AGN, but rather due to stellar activity.

claims.hypothesis: Do the nuclear outflow velocities show AGN activity?
claims.experiment: Multi-component Gaussian fits of Pa-alpha, [Fe II] and H2 lines, v_max and W80
claims.result: v_max up to ~550 km/s in nuclei and ~900 km/s off-nuclear
claims.finding: Velocities do not conclusively demonstrate AGN activity

evidence.quote: However, they do not conclusively represent a direct evidence of AGN activity.

claims.hypothesis: Can NIR emission-line diagnostics separate AGN from supernova/starburst ionisation?
claims.experiment: Extinction-corrected line ratios on Riffel2013, Colina2015 and Calabro2023 diagrams
claims.result: Nuclei lie in AGN/AGN+supernova regions or slightly above maximum starburst line
claims.finding: Diagnostics cannot distinguish supernova and AGN ionisation

evidence.quote: In summary, these diagnostics do not allow us to distinguish between supernovae and AGN ionisation mechanisms.

claims.hypothesis: Can the NIRSpec data explain the discrepancy between NIR and radio/far-IR star-formation tracers?
claims.experiment: Pa-alpha and 3.3 um PAH SFRs for each region compared with radio/far-IR values
claims.result: NIR SFRs are far below radio/far-IR SFRs
claims.finding: NIRSpec SFRs do not resolve the existing discrepancy

evidence.quote: Summarising, the NIRSpec-based SFR measurements do not offer a solution to the existing discrepancy among various star-formation tracers identified in previous studies.

claims.hypothesis: Is an AGN present in the Arp 220 nuclei?
claims.experiment: Search for AGN features in NIRSpec spectra within 55 pc
claims.result: No unambiguous AGN features; A_V ~ 11-14 from recombination lines
claims.finding: AGN presence neither confirmed nor excluded because of extreme obscuration

evidence.quote: To conclude, an unambiguous identification of the presence of AGN in the Arp 220 system remains elusive.

evidence.quote: which have narrower wavelength coverage and are affected by telluric features.

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA role is limited to astrometric registration; no ALMA reduction or measurement is described
Positional offsets are applied without stated uncertainty
Tabulated line fluxes come from single-Gaussian fits only, while kinematics use multi-component fits
Choice of 1 vs 2 components by BIC without stated priors or fit uncertainties method
No aperture corrections, so luminosities are lower limits for extended emission
